litellm.notes: Files do not specify single-test commands or naming conventions.

comfyui.notes: CI uses custom comfy-action. Naming convention not specified in provided files.

hermes.notes: CI uses a custom Python script for parallel test slicing; specific test runner and paths are not defined.

langfuse.notes: Monorepo using Turbo; suite command found in package.json, but specific test runner and paths are not detailed.

adk.notes: Tox runs pytest on tests/unittests. Single-file execution and naming conventions are not specified.

dify.suite: uv run --project api pytest -p no:benchmark --timeout "${PYTEST_TIMEOUT:-20}" -n auto api/tests/unit_tests api/providers/vdb/*/tests/unit_tests api/providers/trace/*/tests/unit_tests --ignore=api/test
dify.notes: Controller tests run separately without xdist. Integration tests also use pytest.

openclaw.notes: Test runner is Vitest, configured in test/vitest/vitest.config.ts. Tests live in the test directory.

spec-kit.notes: Uses pytest via uv. Ruff lints src and tests.

gemini-cli.notes: Vitest is used to run tests across multiple workspaces and specific configuration directories.

llama-index.notes: CI uses llama-dev, Makefile uses pants, and contributing guide recommends uv run -- pytest.

mem0.notes: Tests use pytest and are executed via hatch or make.

crawl4ai.notes: CONTRIBUTING.md mentions running pytest to verify, but no test directories, naming conventions, or single-file commands are specified.

firecrawl.one_file: pnpm harness pnpm exec vitest run path/to/test.ts
firecrawl.suite: pnpm harness pnpm test:snips (API) or pnpm run test (JS SDK)
firecrawl.notes: Run commands from their respective app directories (apps/api or apps/js-sdk/firecrawl).

autogpt.notes: Run from 'classic' dir. CI uses Poetry, MinIO, and Playwright.
